title: Professional-services (sustainability / ESG consultancy) marketing-site generation policy

classification.marketModel: B2B / public-sector advisory and engineering consultancy selling bespoke engagements; no software product, no self-serve plans
audiences: companies, utilities and investors seeking sustainability / ESG advice

consultancySignals.claim: the company describes itself as an interdisciplinary sustainability consultancy
consultancySignals.anchor: Interdisciplinary sustainability consultancy with 45 years of experience.

consultancySignals.claim: the offer is a set of advisory capabilities (strategy, energy/carbon, water, finance, crisis communications, capacity building), not software features
proof is client engagements for utilities, governments and retailers (case-study slides), not product screenshots or integrations
consultancySignals.anchor: We support EDP in developing and implementing renewable generation solutions

consultancySignals.claim: the people are an executive/consulting team presented as a roster
consultancySignals.anchor: Our executive team brings decades of experience

consultancySignals.claim: the only conversion is a newsletter signup and a LinkedIn follow; no trial, demo, login or purchase

classificationEvidence.saasSignalsAbsent: grep of src/ (excluding the privacy text), 2026-10-29: 0 matches for pricing|price|per month|subscription|sign in|log in|dashboard|free trial|demo|integration|per seat. The clone serves 3 routes (/, /privacy-policy, catch-all 404); there is no app, account or pricing surface.

notBoundTo.n0-saas-design-constraints-common: Explicitly NOT applied. That policy assumes a B2B SaaS product (pricing tiers, product dashboards and screenshots, feature matrices, integrations, trial/demo funnels). Equator is a consultancy whose site is a single long-form brand page plus a privacy policy; binding it to the SaaS policy would require a recorded architecture decision, which has not been made.

generationRules: Pages are drawn only from the 3 templates (home, legal, not-found) and 14 section contracts in this repo; no new section types and no SaaS constructs (pricing tables, product screenshots, feature matrices, integrations, trial/demo CTAs).
Mode is explicit: clone reproduces Equator for fidelity work; generation builds a page for another organisation and must contain no Equator identity or content.
Brand: no Equator / The Equator Company / S317 name, spelling variant or domain (GENERATION_MODE_BRAND).
People: no real employee names, slugs or likenesses; team rosters use fictional people with fictional-avatar media (GENERATION_MODE_PERSON, GENERATION_MODE_ASSET).
Customers and partners: no merged-company, client, programme or design-studio names, and no real logos; placeholder-company-logo only (GENERATION_MODE_CUSTOMER).

Claims: no Equator experience figures, project statistics, awards or public-funding claims (PRR / Recuperar Portugal / EU strip); funding emblems and project sheets appear only if the operator supplies its own verified ones (GENERATION_MODE_CLAIM, blocked-for-generation roles).
Copy: no Equator copy, checked as hashed 5-word shingles after normalisation (GENERATION_MODE_COPY).

Links: placeholder:, relative, in-page anchors or reserved .example / .invalid hosts only; no Equator, LinkedIn, Mailchimp, Google Maps, partner or government URL or email (GENERATION_MODE_URL, GENERATION_MODE_EMBED).

Assets: only generation-safe roles; no source: refs, no real file names or asset stems (GENERATION_MODE_ASSET). There are no product screenshots in the source, so no separate screenshot rule exists; slide photography is covered by the asset rule.
Tokens: only catalog token ids in policy-allowed slots, theme 'light' only (TOKEN_* rules); National 2 needs the deployer's own licence.

approval.note: Classification and rules were written by an agent (agent attestation, not a human sign-off). A human architecture owner must ratify the non-SaaS binding; licensing of real assets and the National 2 font remains open.
